reason: The tooling-isolation rule was learned from a real failure in which an in-process RuleTestCase broke unrelated agent-map tests, but its recorded canonical home was a shell script and a PHPStan config, neither of which can observe a newly added PHPUnit class. The rule was therefore true and unenforced for months. Replacing the canonical home with the static rule keeps the same rule and gives it a detector.
boundary: The rule governs where fixtures execute; it does not restrict what the fixtures may assert.
